name: rogue
why: The 1980 original dungeon crawler that spawned the roguelike genre, a classic old-school terminal game worth playing.

brief.what_it_is: The SourceForge page for The Roguelike Restoration Project, an effort to restore and further develop orphaned roguelike games. The page names rogue, xrogue, UltraRogue and Advanced Rogue as the primary targets, and says other roguelikes may be adopted. The page is a project listing rather than a game README, and it describes a C program with a curses/ncurses user interface under a BSD license, for BSD, Linux and Windows. It does not describe gameplay, inputs or outputs in detail.
brief.why_it_exists: The page states that the project is for the restoration and further development of a variety of orphaned roguelike games.
brief.install_notes: The page shows no build, install or configuration steps. It lists a SourceForge download, with the operating systems BSD, Linux and Windows. The listed version was last updated 2013-09-19.
brief.standout: It is a preservation project covering several historic rogue variants rather than one standalone game, so the entry may be better framed as a restoration effort than as a single game.
brief.status: quiet. The SourceForge page shows a last update of 2013-09-19 and 0 downloads this week. I found no newer release or commit information on the fetched page.
brief.caveats: The homepage is a SourceForge listing for the Roguelike Restoration Project, not a page for the 1980 original rogue. The scout note's claims about 1980 and the origin of the roguelike genre are not supported by this page. The page gives no README, docs, or install steps. The page's linked project website was not in the fetched text, so I could not check it. The fetched HTML is mostly site navigation and unrelated ads.
quotes: This project is for the restoration and further development of a variety of orphaned roguelike games.
Primarily rogue, xrogue, UltraRogue and Advanced Rogue but other roguelike games may be adopted by this project as required.
fetch_log: https://sourceforge.net/projects/roguelike/ - fetched successfully. It returned the SourceForge project listing for The Roguelike Restoration Project, not a README. I did not follow further links because the project website URL was not present in the fetched text.
